jess (docs): Quick FYI — opened PR to fix /files/upload API examples. The curl example currently shows a JSON body (`{ files: [...] }`) but the endpoint expects multipart/form-data when sending files. Will push updated examples. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3422

omar (sdk): Thanks — yep that's wrong. Node snippet in the docs uses `JSON.stringify` today. We should show FormData + `fs.createReadStream` example. e.g.:
```js
const fd = new FormData();
fd.append('files', fs.createReadStream('./a.png'), 'a.png');
const res = await fetch(url, {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${TOKEN}` },
  body: fd
});
```

liz (eng-runtime): Confirming runtime accepts repeated `files` fields (multipart parts) and requires a Content-Disposition filename for each part. Also note we added support for `filename*` for utf-8 filenames a while back — docs should mention that for non-ascii names.

ryan (docs-review): Python requests snippet needs update too. Recommend: 
```python
files = [('files', ('a.png', open('a.png','rb'))), ('files', ('b.png', open('b.png','rb')))]
resp = requests.post(url, headers={'Authorization': f'Bearer {TOKEN}'}, files=files)
```

jess (docs): Good catches. I'll update curl, Python, and Node snippets and add a short migration note: "If you previously sent a JSON array payload for files, switch to multipart/form-data; SDKs v2.1.0+ provide helpers to abstract this."

omar (sdk): On the SDK side I'll add a `client.uploadFiles(files[])` helper that wraps FormData and streams. I'll push a tiny PR and link it in the docs once both are ready. ETA EOD.

ci-bot: docs-ci: running linter and markdown checks... (3 warnings about example formatting remain)

jess (docs): Pushed fixes for curl + python + node snippets in PR, updated description and added a migration note. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3422

ryan (docs-review): Quick review done — one nit: header example shows `authorization: Bearer ...` lowercase. Prefer `Authorization` canonical casing in examples so it matches other docs.

liz (eng-runtime): No runtime changes required. Just document that the endpoint accepts multiple `files` fields and that each must include a filename in Content-Disposition.

jess (docs): :thumbsup: tagging @omar when SDK helper PR is ready I'll add a link to the helper in the migration note. Anybody want to draft a release-note blurb?

omar (sdk): I can draft the release note and include the sample code snippet we prefer.

ryan (docs-review): Approving pending CI green.
